activity.notes: Bertrand du Guesclin entered the service of Charles V and was made Constable of France on 2 October 1370. He retained the constableship through the renewed Hundred Years' War campaigns until his death at Châteauneuf-de-Randon on 13 July 1380. ATLAS records this formal office rather than his earlier and more fragmented Breton and Castilian military service.

sources.title: Bertrand Duguesclin — Bibliothèque nationale de France
sources.citation_text: The Bibliothèque nationale de France states that Charles V presented Bertrand du Guesclin with the sword of constable on 2 October 1370.

sources.title: Guesclin (Bertrand du) — Larousse
sources.citation_text: Larousse identifies du Guesclin as Constable of France, describes his 1370 appointment and campaigns against the English, and gives his death in 1380.

sources.title: Mort de Du Guesclin — POP, Ministère de la Culture
sources.citation_text: The French Ministry of Culture collection record dates the represented death of Bertrand du Guesclin to 13 July 1380 at Châteauneuf-de-Randon.
